decision.reason: [ev-67a96855ff1b] is just a one-line title saying CRD "view" RBAC rules were moved to the provider system role. It doesn't name the exact resource, API group, verbs, or the role they were moved from. The proposed name "customresourcedefinitions/view" uses "view", which is a word from the title, not a stated RBAC verb, so the subject identity is guessed rather than copied from the evidence. Deciding this needs the PR #6677 diff or the rendered ClusterRole artifacts showing the rules before and after.
